_comment: Which platform each restaurant actually takes bookings through, keyed by Tabelog shop id.
None of these nine can be booked on Tabelog itself, so this mapping is what the radar
hangs on. It lives in the repo because data/ is gitignored and this is the part that
`verifiedBy` says how the identity was confirmed — a name match alone is not enough:
searching OMAKASE for 蒼 also returns 蒼洋軒 and 蒼菓.

13243463.verifiedBy: linked from the shop's own site ao-nishiazabu.com; phone and address both match Tabelog
